display.name: SendGrid
display.blurb: Send transactional email and manage marketing contacts, lists, templates, suppressions, and stats via the SendGrid v3 API. The API key is brokered — injected at the egress proxy, never seen by the agent.

cli.doc:
Use `sendgrid` to drive the SendGrid v3 API from this session — send transactional email and manage marketing contacts, lists, templates, suppressions, and stats. Authentication is automatic: the egress proxy injects the org's SendGrid API key (Authorization: Bearer …) on every request to api.sendgrid.com; `SENDGRID_API_KEY` is a managed placeholder. Do NOT set a real key or run any login. Each subcommand needs the matching power on your profile; a call to a path your profile didn't grant is denied at the network boundary, not authenticated.

Subcommands and the power each needs:
  sendgrid send <to> <from> <subject> <text...>   Send a plain-text email (needs `mail:send`; POST /v3/mail/send).
  sendgrid templates [field=value ...]            List dynamic templates (needs `templates:read`; GET /v3/templates). Tip: `sendgrid templates generations=dynamic`.
  sendgrid contacts [field=value ...]             List marketing contacts (needs `contacts:read`; GET /v3/marketing/contacts).
  sendgrid contact-search <sql>                   Search contacts by SGQL (needs `contacts:read`; POST /v3/marketing/contacts/search).
  sendgrid upsert-contact <json>                  Add/update contacts from a JSON body (needs `contacts:write`; PUT /v3/marketing/contacts).
  sendgrid lists [field=value ...]                List marketing lists (needs `lists:read`; GET /v3/marketing/lists).
  sendgrid bounces [field=value ...]              List bounce suppressions (needs `suppressions:read`; GET /v3/suppression/bounces).
  sendgrid stats [field=value ...]                Global email stats (needs `stats:read`; GET /v3/stats — requires start_date, e.g. `sendgrid stats start_date=2026-06-01`).
  sendgrid scopes                                 Show the API key's granted scopes (any read power; GET /v3/scopes).
  sendgrid get <path> [field=value ...]           Raw GET of any /v3 path with query params.
  sendgrid api <METHOD> <path> [json-body]        Raw call (GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) with an optional JSON body.

Paths may be given with or without the leading /v3. Responses are JSON (pretty-printed when jq is present).
